subject: Pilot runbook & decision orchestration (post-call recap)
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@skylinehealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@skylinehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot runbook & next steps (post-call recap)

Thanks for the time today — good alignment on scope. I wanted to capture the runbook and next steps so everyone has a single source of truth. Please read and confirm the success criteria and timeline below so we can lock the exec readout window.

High-level objective:
- Run a 2-week pilot that validates Redwood’s inference pipeline for Skyline’s triage + summarization use case and gives procurement the business case for a contract.

Proposed pilot scope & success criteria (please confirm):
- Functionality: triage classification + 1-paragraph summary for inbound messages.
- Latency: p95 end-to-end <= 150ms (measured from request -> first token) under expected pilot load.
- Throughput: sustain 100 requests/min with <= burst up to 250 req/min.
- Quality: semantic match (human-labeled test set) mean cosine >= 0.82 OR F1 >= 0.70 on classification.
- Safety/regulatory: no PII exfiltration during pilot; provide answers to your compliance questionnaire.
- False-positive rate target (we discussed this): < 5% for triage category assigned to "actionable".

Pilot timeline (proposed):
- 11/19: test environment provisioned (Redwood infra + sample dataset)
- 11/22–12/06: pilot execution (2 full weeks)
- 12/07–12/09: internal readouts + final metrics consolidation
- week of 12/14: exec readout and go/no-go; procurement review to follow immediately after if go.

Attachments (initial): pilot-runbook-v1.xlsx (runbook + test plan).

Immediate asks from Skyline:
1) Confirm acceptance of the success criteria (latency, throughput, quality thresholds).
2) Share procurement contact and any SSO/KMS requirements for the test env.
3) Confirm the decision owner and who will attend the exec readout (VP product / CTO / procurement).

Internal notes / owners:
- Marcus Lin: solution & evaluation harness (will own measurement instrumentation).
- Neha Kapoor: onboarding & exec scheduling.
- Lauren Bishop: overall AE owner and exec agenda.

If that all looks good, we’ll finalize the runbook and send a meeting invite for the exec readout options.

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Pilot runbook & next steps (post-call recap)

Lauren — thanks for the clear summary. Confirming we’re aligned on most points; a couple of clarifications and one additional metric from our side: 

- Agreed on latency and throughput targets.
- Quality: we’ll use the labeled dataset we discussed — Raj will share the latest extract (anonymized) by 11/18.
- Additional metric: false-positive rate for "actionable" triage should remain < 5% across the pilot.
- Procurement contact: procurement@skylinehealth.com (they’ll handle SOW/PO).

I attached the compliance questionnaire you requested; Marcus, please flag any areas that need an evidence artifact.

We can do the pilot start timeline you proposed once environment details are shared.

—Emma

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Emma Jones <emma.jones@skylinehealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@skylinehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T12:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot runbook & next steps (technical clarifications)

Quick tech notes and measurement plan so there’s no ambiguity on how we’ll validate success: 

- Measurement: for semantic similarity we’ll compute embeddings (open-similarity model) and report mean cosine + distribution. The pass condition will be mean >= 0.82 OR per-class F1 >= 0.70 depending on which correlates better with Skyline labels.
- FP measurement: we will run the triage classifier against the labeled set and report FP rate with a 95% CI.
- Instrumentation: we’ll add request traces and token-level timing. Marcus (me) will share the evaluation harness spec.
- Data / env: Raj — please provide S3 path or a small anonymized sample by 11/18 so we can begin data onboarding. If there are KMS keys required for the sample dataset we’ll need those before 11/19.

I’ve attached an internal evaluation-harness-spec.md with the exact metrics and scripts we’ll run. Lauren — once Emma & Raj sign off I’ll triage the infra tickets and request the test instance.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Final readout agenda, decision rubric & next-contract steps (Dec 8)

Thanks Emma — great. Confirmed: Dec 8, 10:00 AM PT. Calendar invite will follow. Below is the readout agenda and the decision rubric Marcus and I will use during the exec.

Readout agenda (30–40m):
- 10:00–10:05: Introductions & goals (Lauren)
- 10:05–10:20: Pilot metrics vs. success criteria (Marcus)
- 10:20–10:30: Demo / representative outputs (Marcus)
- 10:30–10:35: Risks / mitigation (Neha)
- 10:35–10:40: Go/no-go decision and procurement next steps (Lauren + Skyline leadership)

Decision rubric (go condition = all must be reasonable / yes):
1) Quality: semantic mean >= 0.82 OR classification F1 >= 0.70 AND FP rate for "actionable" < 5%
2) Performance: p95 latency <= 150ms and throughput goal hit or a clear scaling plan identified
3) Compliance: no unresolved critical items from the compliance questionnaire
4) Commercial: procurement prepared to sign SOW/PO within 5 business days after go decision

If the exec confirms go, next steps for contracting:
- Marcus will prepare the SOW + final pricing (target delivery: 2 business days after go).
- We will send a DocuSign packet for Skyline review: https://docusign.com/SH-2026-1123
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/SH-2026-1123 (internal tracking).

Attachments: I’ve attached final-pilot-runbook-v1.1.xlsx (runbook with finalized measurement sections). Please review and flag any last-minute items before 11/24 so Marcus can prep the SOW.

Owners recap:
